First segment handling and at least one SomeIpT- pRxNSdu of the affected SomeIpTpRxChannel is in state NSDU_AVAILABLE If a SOME/IP segment is successfully received with Offset Field set to 0 via a config- ured SomeIpTpRxNPdu and at least one SomeIpTpRxNSdu of the affected SomeIpT- pRxChannel is in state NSDU_AVAILABLE , then the SOME/IP TP module shall per- form the following actions. Otherwise, if all configured SomeIpTpRxNSdu s of the affected SomeIpTpRxChannel are in state NSDU_IN_USE , report a runtime error SOMEIPTP_E_ALL_RX_NSDUS_IN_USE and return: • Start the Rx timeout time defined by SomeIpTpRxTimeoutTime. • Set the corresponding SomeIpTpRxNSdu to state NSDU_IN_USE . • Call the API PduR_SomeIpTpStartOfReception() with the PDU ID derived from the parameter SomeIpTpRxSduRef and the TpSduLength set to ’0’.
